mobbin:3c0845a8-624f-4a47-ad80-e57ab4bb1.summary: moves from an empty day calendar into the Home dashboard. They scan sales and appointment headline numbers and activity, then scroll to today's next appointments plus this-month-versus-last-month service and team tables.
steps: Empty day calendar with staff columns and 60% setup progress
Home with $0 sales, empty upcoming, and today's list
Home with sales $636, 17 booked upcoming, and cancelled activity
Sales chart with a Tuesday point tip
Scrolled view: activity, today's next, and top services or team
Top services and top team this month versus last month
steal: Today's next appointments list shows time, BOOKED or STARTED status, client, duration, and staff (screens 2-6), so the dashboard agenda hands off into Scheduling.
The recent sales card shows a big number, appointment count and value, and a dual trend line for the last 7 days (screens 2-4).
When the schedule is empty, the upcoming card says so honestly instead of showing fake charts (screen 2).
Header 'Complete Setup' progress (60% to 100%) stays visible on Home (screens 1-6) without owning the whole page.
avoid: Today's rows show status only, with no Start, Check-in, or Open session control on the card (screens 2-6). Essentials still needs a direct jump into Recording or Debrief from the agenda item.
mobbin:3c0845a8-624f-4a47-ad80-e57ab4bb1.fit: Dashboard: replaces a weak tile-only home with a compact headline-number strip and today's agenda that clicks through into Scheduling, and later Recording or Debrief. Report tables hand off into Reports, not a second Reports home.

mobbin:7df9c1e2-cfd5-4c9f-84eb-718683ff8.summary: From a first-run setup panel over an empty day calendar, the user reaches a populated week view and opens a flagged No-show appointment tip.
steps: Empty day calendar with setup panel for team, hours, and try tasks
Multi-staff day grid empty, with a current-time line and 60% setup
Week view with appointment blocks and a current-time line
No-show tip on a flagged appointment
steal: A staff-as-columns day grid with a red current-time line (screens 1-2) maps to rooms-as-columns center overview on the dashboard or Scheduling.
A right-side first-run checklist with Start or Try now per task sits over the empty calendar (screen 1).
Week blocks colour or flag exceptions, and a No-show tip shows client, service, and duration (screens 3-4) without leaving the schedule.
avoid: A full week or day calendar as the default home (screens 1-4) duplicates Scheduling. The baseline already has Center Overview plus Calendar, so the dashboard should summarize today instead.
mobbin:7df9c1e2-cfd5-4c9f-84eb-718683ff8.fit: Dashboard: steals multi-column 'now' overview and No-show exception for a dashboard to Scheduling handoff. The setup panel lives on the dashboard for first-run, not as a second calendar module.
